```json
{"Endpoint":"https://management.azure.com","Audience":"https://management.azure.com/","DefaultScope":"https://management.azure.com//.default"}
```

- `Endpoint` (Uri)
- `Audience` (string) 
- `DefaultScope` (string)

```json
{"Endpoint":"https://management.azure.com","Audience":"https://management.azure.com/","DefaultScope":"https://management.azure.com//.default"}
```
